_exemptionNotes.products/card-text-budget: ProductExplorer (Catalog sub-view) cards combine name, status, category, and description — they are the disclosure level. ProductComparisonView decision recommendation cards render a full recommendation sentence by design. Both are intentional; exemption covers both sub-views.
_exemptionNotes.deployment-impact/card-text-budget: DeploymentComparisonSelector uses full-sentence comparison titles by design — these are the primary navigational labels, not secondary description text.
_exemptionNotes.decisions/unit-box-width: Decision guide option buttons span the grid width in 2-3 column layouts at 1440px. The 360px max is appropriate for the capability unit boxes; decision guide option buttons are wider by design (they contain a question text, not just a product name).
_exemptionNotes.decisions/card-text-budget: Decision guide question cards accumulate the full question text, option labels, and path hints in their visible text; this is the disclosure level for the guide. Exempts the card-text-budget check for all decision-guide states.
_exemptionNotes.products/row-fill: Search-filtered catalog results may produce a single orphan card when the query returns one match. This is correct filtered-state behavior; enforcing balance on dynamic search results would require artificial padding.
_exemptionNotes.products/no-ghost-cells: Search-filtered results may produce a single item in a 3-col grid. Correct filtered-state behavior; resting state has full rows.
_exemptionNotes.architecture/card-text-budget: Generate-from-Environment mode renders multi-field form sections whose aggregate text exceeds 140 chars by design. Blueprints mode shows comparison descriptions that are inherently verbose. Both are deliberate disclosure levels for their interaction mode.
_exemptionNotes.architecture/control-scale: ArchitectureHub header (mode-selector text tabs ~16px) and CapabilityArchitectureView action bar (compact buttons ~36px) are two distinct surfaces within the first 300px, each internally consistent. The control-scale check fires on their combination. Both surfaces comply with the density law within themselves.
_exemptionNotes.architecture/unit-box-width: Interactive Builder mid-wizard renders compact next/action buttons (flex shrink) that fall below the 200px min. These are navigation controls, not capability unit boxes. The min-width bound targets standalone capability cards, not inline wizard navigation.
